recurrence_review.method: Minimum direct-CALL count on captured source-comment CFG; CALL cost 1, branch and caller-continuation cost 0.
recurrence_review.evidence_scope: The final target is dynamically observed by CALL history; paths and minimum depths are structural inference, not dynamic branch traces.
limitations: Conditional branches are treated structurally; feasibility and actual branch order are not inferred.
The graph is the captured selected generation-4 graph, not every possible path in the full kernel.
RET history destinations are initial seeds; no invented return edge lowers a caller depth.
Unique target histories do not attribute each handback or prove complete delegated MM execution.
Core symbol labels come from the retained matched-kernel symbol list; module targets are not symbolized.
